NLCT-M1.description: Nonlinear Analysis Control Data (NLCT-M1). LC_SCOPE decides whether one global setting (ALL, key must be 1) or per-load-case settings (SELECT, requires LOAD_CASE) apply; ITER_METHOD (FORCE/ARC/DISP) and LOAD_STEPS.STEP_MODE (AUTO/MANUAL) drive which nested fields are meaningful.

LC_SCOPE.description: Load case scope (case-insensitive). ALL = one global nonlinear control (key must be 1); SELECT = per static load case (LOAD_CASE required).

LOAD_CASE.description: [LC_SCOPE=SELECT] Static load case name; must reference an existing static load case. Required when LC_SCOPE=SELECT and the key is a new entry.

NONLINEAR_TYPE.description: Nonlinear type (case-insensitive). GEOM = geometry nonlinear, MATL = material nonlinear, GEOM+MATL = both.

ITER_METHOD.description: Iteration method (case-insensitive). FORCE = force control (Newton-Raphson), ARC = arc-length, DISP = displacement control. Governs which LOAD_STEPS sub-fields apply.

LOAD_STEPS.description: Load step configuration. STEP_MODE selects increment definition; ARC and DISP methods enable extra sub-fields.

STEP_MODE.description: Step mode (case-insensitive). AUTO = fixed number of equal increments (uses NUMBER_STEPS, OUTPUT); MANUAL = user-defined step list (uses MANUAL_STEPS).

OUTPUT.description: [STEP_MODE=AUTO] Intermediate output request. EVERY = output at every increment, LAST = only the last increment (case-insensitive).

MANUAL_STEPS.description: [STEP_MODE=MANUAL] User-defined list of load increment factors, one per step.

MIN_ARC_RATIO.description: [ITER_METHOD=ARC] Minimum arc-length adjustment ratio (default applied internally: 0.25).

MAX_ARC_RATIO.description: [ITER_METHOD=ARC] Maximum arc-length adjustment ratio (default applied internally: 4.0).

MAX_ARC_INCREMENTS.description: [ITER_METHOD=ARC] Maximum number of arc-length increments (default applied internally: 100).

MASTER_NODE.description: [ITER_METHOD=DISP] Master node number whose displacement is controlled.

MAX_DISP.description: [ITER_METHOD=DISP] Maximum controlled displacement at the master node.

OPT_USE.description: Whether a reference node is used for relative displacement control.

CONV_CRITERIA.description: Convergence criteria. Each of DISP/LOAD/WORK toggles a criterion and supplies its tolerance.

VALUE.description: Displacement convergence tolerance (meaningful when OPT_USE=true; internal default 0.001).
Load convergence tolerance (meaningful when OPT_USE=true; internal default 0.001).
Work convergence tolerance (meaningful when OPT_USE=true; internal default 0.000001).

ADVANCED.description: Advanced nonlinear parameters. When OPT_USE_DEFAULT=true the remaining fields are ignored (defaults used); when false they configure the solver.

OPT_USE_DEFAULT.description: Use default advanced settings. If true, all fields below are ignored.

STIFF_UPDATE_SCHEME.description: [OPT_USE_DEFAULT=false] Stiffness update scheme (case-insensitive). CUSTOM = update every N iterations (uses ITER_BEFORE_STIFF_UPDATE); FULL_NEWTON_RAPHSON = update every iteration; INITIAL_STIFF = keep initial stiffness.

ITER_BEFORE_STIFF_UPDATE.description: [STIFF_UPDATE_SCHEME=CUSTOM] Number of iterations before each stiffness update.

MAX_ITER_PER_INCREMENT.description: [OPT_USE_DEFAULT=false] Maximum number of iterations per increment.

DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD.description: [OPT_USE_DEFAULT=false] Divergence threshold (stored as an integer count internally).

OPT_ENABLE_LINE_SEARCH.description: [OPT_USE_DEFAULT=false] Enable line search. If true, LINE_SEARCH_OPTION must be supplied (hard-validated).

LINE_SEARCH_OPTION.description: [OPT_ENABLE_LINE_SEARCH=true] Line search option (case-insensitive). AUTO = automatic; MANUAL = user-defined (uses MAX_LINE_SEARCH_PER_ITER, LINE_SEARCH_TOL).
